limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the source-review author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The lab Help and formal readers serve the article bytes committed at 3fa407e3, which differ from the reviewed corrected bytes. Steps followed the reviewed bytes against the app. Reader checks prove the routes, headings and UI behavior; link checks opened every internal link of the reviewed bytes in the bundled formal reader.
The admin lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. The walkthrough created only records named DOC-029 support ... and changed no organisation settings.

Two earlier recorded attempts (walkthrough-r1-attempt1.json, walkthrough-r1-attempt2.json) each had one reviewer harness fault and are kept with their disposition. Exploratory probes and development runs before them are not evidence.

Signing and Analysis were observed unconfigured in this lab (DocuSign Not connected, AI Provider Not connected). The Signed Envelope, Executed copy filing, Kept, Unverified, Retry Request-context Analysis, purple border, sparkle evidence and Conversion draft preparation checks were not exercised; the provider stand-in groups verify those workflows, and neither is live-provider evidence.
Email delivery, spam filtering and morning briefing timing were not exercised. The walkthrough checked only the preference and Timezone controls the article names.
Page-could-not-load was produced by blocking the browser's request for one Contract read, as a controlled fixture, not by a real network outage.

The save error shown for an out-of-range Notice period was the general message "One or more request fields are invalid.", not a field-specific correction. The article's reload check still showed what saved.
The Contributor role no longer exists at this build, so no Contributor walkthrough was run. Ravi Menon is a Business User in this lab and was not used.

compatibilityReview.summary: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 and found no change to record not-found pages, Portal pages, uploads, previews, notifications, Approval, signing or Analysis; the sign-in page gains branding only. I replayed the round 1 V-C49 walkthrough on the admin2 lab and all 30 steps passed.
